scene: A wide panoramic cartoon of a cosy, bright little app workshop seen from the front, all the action in a central horizontal band with calm open sky-blue wall space above and below. On the left half, two friendly cartoon people at a workbench happily assemble glowing app tiles and puzzle-piece shaped tools with tiny spanners and a soldering iron, sparks and confetti flying. In the centre, Phoney the blue phone character proudly holds up a freshly built glowing tool like a trophy, and Corey the green sprout sits on top of a toolbox giving a big thumbs-up with a leaf-arm. On the right, a conveyor belt carries finished little gift boxes off towards a small queue of happy small-business owners: a baker in an apron, a florist and a cafe owner. Warm, playful, bright, uncluttered, lots of breathing room on the far right side.
